uniform_conversion: (raw64 >> 11) * 2^-53 for every engine; MT19937 combines two consecutive raw32 outputs low word first

montmory_contract.core: recovered original mmc_core.c; branchless algebraic implementation checked against original

functional_sample_sizes: N for single-coordinate functions, N/2 disjoint pairs for pair functions
null_reference: IID continuous uniform nominal; discrete output grid differences explicitly not treated as exact zero

multi_lane.pairing: adjacent disjoint lanes at matching positions

inference.method: paired seed-group means of squared errors, one-sided t approximation, Bonferroni over 9 competitors x 6 workloads
inference.advantage_rule: ratio <0.90, adjusted p<0.05, and ratio<1 in both prespecified halves groups 0..63 and 64..127
inference.diagnostic_family: all variance/binomial/structural/lane aggregate KS p-values combined with Bonferroni; descriptive, approximate calibrations identified

timing.scope: host interface seed initialization + raw generation + common 53-bit conversion; separate from GPU timings; not intrinsic engine assembly comparison
timing.ordering: rotate engines each repetition; single process, no concurrent compute jobs in this campaign

limits: Scoped TACM campaign, not SmallCrush/Crush/BigCrush reruns
No native Metal/CUDA execution in this campaign
First 65536 global positions in functional runs use the first 16 logical Montmory lanes; separate cross-lane test covers all 2048
No claim of independent streams from distinct seeds alone
No tuning of generator or diagnostic weights from results
